# Red Deer Investments — AI Library

> Structured content for LLMs and AI agents. This file serves as a machine-readable entrypoint to the AI section.

## Available Books

### From the Gate Up
- Description: How chips actually work, from logic gates to AI silicon. A journey through multiply-accumulate units, muxes, systolic arrays, pipeline registers, FPGAs, cache vs scratchpad, CPU architecture, and the GPU-TPU convergence. Based on the Dwarkesh Podcast conversation with Reiner Pope.
- Landing page: https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/
- Chapters:
  - [Introduction: The Chip in Your Hands](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/00_introduction.html)
  - [Chapter 1: The Multiply-Accumulate Machine](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/01_multiply_accumulate.html)
  - [Chapter 2: The Hidden City of Data Movement](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/02_data_movement.html)
  - [Chapter 3: The Amortization Trick](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/03_systolic_arrays.html)
  - [Chapter 4: The Great Synchronization](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/04_clock_cycles.html)
  - [Chapter 5: The Flexible Frankenstein](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/05_fpgas.html)
  - [Chapter 6: The Two Kinds of Memory](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/06_cache_scratchpad.html)
  - [Chapter 7: The Bloat of Brains](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/07_cpu_cores.html)
  - [Chapter 8: The Wet Chip](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/08_brains_chips.html)
  - [Chapter 9: A Bunch of Tiny Everything](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/09_gpu_tpus.html)
  - [Afterword: What "From the Gate Up" Teaches Us](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/10_afterword.html)
  - [Sources](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/from-the-gate-up/chapters/11_sources.html)

### The Waiting Game
- Description: A journey through the memory wall, KV caches, batch economics, speculative decoding, and custom silicon — explaining why everything in AI slows down before it gets faster.
- Landing page: https://reddeerinv.com/ai/the-waiting-game/
- Chapters:
  - [Introduction: The $30,000 Paperweight](https://reddeerinv.comhttps://reddeerinv.com/ai/the-waiting-game/chapters/00_introduction.html)

### Against Backprop
- Description: A narrative exploration of biologically plausible alternatives to backpropagation — from equilibrium propagation to predictive coding — and why closing the gap between AI and the brain unlocks fundamentally more efficient hardware.
- Landing page: https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/
- Chapters:
  - [Introduction](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-2.html)
  - [1. The Three Sins](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-3.html)
  - [2. The Nudge](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-4.html)
  - [3. Goodness](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-5.html)
  - [4. Prediction](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-6.html)
  - [5. The Neuron That Learns](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-7.html)
  - [6. The Hardware That's Waiting](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-8.html)
  - [Conclusion](https://reddeerinv.com/ai/against-backprop/chapters/chapter-9.html)

## Experiments

### ZAYA1-8B: Observations on the Efficiency Frontier
- Description: A 42-prompt evaluation of ZAYA1-8B, Nemotron 30B-A3B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B separating raw observations from architectural implications — revealing a proof-of-concept whose broken governor masks an intriguing signal about where inference is heading.
- Landing page: https://reddeerinv.com/ai/zaya-evaluation/


## How to read

Each book is rendered as clean semantic HTML with chapter navigation, JSON-LD structured data, and accessible headings. All pages are static HTML — no JavaScript required.

## Metadata format

Every book page includes:
- JSON-LD (schema.org/Book) in the <head>
- Semantic HTML5 landmarks (<article>, <nav>, <section>)
- Reading progress via chapter ordering
- Next/Previous navigation

## Crawl settings

- Rate limit: none (static files on CDN)
- Prefer: text/html
- Sitemap: https://reddeerinv.com/sitemap.xml
